target_customer: Adult children in the Toronto area who pay for in-home care for an aging parent
problem: Families find it hard to find and trust vetted professional caregivers for an elderly parent at home.
business_model: marketplace take rate on in-home care bookings (inferred from the one-liner; no source states pricing)

founders.name: Vanessa Lee
founders.background_notes: YC page lists her with no bio; employers and education not found.

technical_complexity.rationale: A two sided booking and vetting marketplace is standard web engineering; the hard parts were caregiver supply and screening, not technology.

defensibility.rationale: No network effect had formed at launch and local caregiver supply could be recruited by any agency or rival marketplace.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows any incumbent copying or buying Sage Care; the company later went inactive per YC.

market_need_then: A Trend Hunter piece from April 2016 describes Sage as an on-demand senior home care startup serving the Greater Toronto Area, with interviews of caregivers, which indicates the pitch of vetted care at home for aging parents. No independent demand data was found.

branding.domain_note: getsagecare.com, a prefixed domain. It now redirects to an unrelated site (checked 2026-11).

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand was found, and the name is shared by several unrelated companies, including a YC S24 home care startup and a 2025 healthcare navigation company.

outcome_analysis: Sage Care joined YC in Summer 2016 as a Toronto marketplace for vetted in-home senior care and is listed as Inactive. The cause of the stop is not public: no shutdown post-mortem, acquisition or press coverage was found, so failure factors are left empty. Funding appears limited to a small seed reported by one database, and the company name is shared by several later unrelated companies, which makes later history hard to trace.
notes: Trend Hunter page returned 403 on direct fetch; its April 2016 date and description come from the search snippet. The $120K YC seed rests on a single database (Dealroom, seen in a search summary). Dealroom also shows a Toronto Sage Care launching in 2025 with $20M, but other sources describe that as a Palo Alto company founded 2024 with different founders, so it is treated as unrelated. YC status Inactive but exit type left unknown because no shutdown evidence exists. Competitor list is empty because no source dated near the batch naming rivals was found.
